basis: Sunshine Coast dataset description states frogs are counted by sightings or hearing their calls
independent Queensland frog-survey codebook explicitly defines HEA=heard, SEE=seen, SHD=seen and heard, HAN=handled/captured

structural_repair.reason: full parent-survey set has 0.633 coordinate coverage, but exact verbatim locationID identifies a publisher-defined site registry with four unambiguous coordinates
structural_repair.eligibility: retain a parent survey only when all child eventIDs resolve to exactly one verbatim locationID, that locationID has one unique event-table coordinate pair across the full archive, and parent survey has one exact date

allowed_reads: eligible years and exact site labels
number of HEA/SHD species per child event
number of eligible child events with >=2 HEA/SHD species
